thens.text: P-unknown: HTTP 404 with body code BOOK_NOT_FOUND (body has error and code).
P-soldout: HTTP 400 with body code OUT_OF_STOCK.
Independent read: GET /api/cart in the same cookie jar returns no row for S0 and no row for the nonexistent id (read through the cart list, not the POST response).
P-equal: the second add (to exactly stock) succeeds with a 2xx status.
P-plus-one: the third add answers HTTP 400 with code INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.
GET /api/cart shows exactly one row for B with quantity 5 (not 6).
The row quantity read in Then 3 equals the stock of B (5) after the rejected add, so the rejected request changed nothing.
GET /api/cart contains exactly one row for B (no second row).
That row has quantity 3 (1 + 2: added, not replaced).
P-qty-min and P-qty-max: 2xx; GET /api/cart in that jar shows B with quantity 1 and 999 respectively.
P-qty-over, P-qty-zero, P-qty-fraction, P-qty-string: a 4xx rejection (never 5xx), not a 2xx.
P-id-zero, P-id-negative, P-id-fraction: a 4xx rejection (never 5xx).
Every rejection body contains both `error` and `code` fields, and GET /api/cart in that jar has no row created by the rejected request.
Control: G1's GET /api/cart lists B with quantity 2 (the guest sees its own row).

P-user: JU's GET /api/cart payload (request carrying both U's session and G1's guest cookie) contains no row for B and none of G1's rows (payload inspected directly; a user-owner query that also matches the guest sessionId would return B x2 here).
P-other-guest: G2's GET /api/cart payload contains no row for B and none of G1's rows (payload inspected directly).
P-overlap-higher-guest: B2 in U's cart has quantity 4 (guest 4 over user 1: max, not sum 5).
P-overlap-higher-user: B1 in U's cart has quantity 5 (user 5 over guest 2: max, not sum 7).
P-cap: B3 in U's cart has quantity 3 (guest 6 capped at stock 3).
P-soldout: U's cart has no row for B4.
P-disjoint: B5 is in U's cart with quantity 2; U's cart contains exactly the rows B1 x5, B2 x4, B3 x3, B5 x2 (and no row for B4).
P-unauth: the merge without a session answers 401.
P-set-equal: PUT succeeds (2xx) and the read-back row for B has quantity 5 (set, not added to 1).
P-over: PUT answers 400 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.
After P-over the read-back row for B still has quantity 5.
P-delete: DELETE succeeds and the final GET /api/cart has no row for B.
Foreign PUT answers HTTP 404 with code CART_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.
Foreign DELETE answers HTTP 404 with code CART_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.
A's after_read rows are identical to the before_read rows (row R_A for K, quantity 2); mutable entity checked: CartItem only.

Positive control: A's own PUT succeeds and the next read shows K with quantity 3, proving R_A is reachable and mutable by its owner (so the 404s and the unchanged state are not an artifact of an unreachable id).
B's own GET /api/cart payload has no row for K.

P-empty: the quote answers 400/409/422 (not 401, 404 or 5xx) with a JSON body carrying `error` and `code`, and issues no quote (no quote items in the body). The signed-in session is proven by Then 2 succeeding on the same jar and path.
P-quote: the quote lists B1 x2 and B2 x1 (items and quantities read from the quote body match the cart read from GET /api/cart).

P-overstock: the quote answers 400/409/422 (not 401, 404 or 5xx) with a JSON body carrying `error` and `code`, and the body or message identifies B1 (the item above stock); no quote items are issued. Exact code value is not asserted (Q1).
P-order: the order succeeds (2xx) with items B1 x2 and B2 x1.
After the order GET /api/cart as U has no row for B1 or B2 (cart cleared).
The add call for B completes successfully (2xx) after the click.
The cart badge text equals the sum of quantities in the cart, 1.
The cart page lists B (by its unique title) with quantity 1; the content, not just the page visibility, is asserted.
